name: strikking
notes: Shared by every Den lille strikkeskolen course. `terms` is sent to Whisper as its prompt (keep it short: Whisper reads about 224 tokens). `replacements` fixes known misreadings in every transcript when the graph is built; add a pair here once and all courses get it on the next run, no new transcription needed. `drop_phrases` removes known Whisper hallucinations (credit lines it invents at silences) from every transcript.
drop_phrases: Takk for at du så på!
